Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Quick 15-minute inference review — noticed a spike on your account

Hi Sam,

I noticed a recent spike in token usage from your account (nice work getting traffic!) and wanted to offer a quick 15-minute check-in to make sure you're getting the best latency and unit cost out of the deployment. A short call typically helps us: 

- Confirm whether that activity pattern is expected or anomalous
- Suggest immediate, low-effort tweaks (batching, prefix caching, model variant) to reduce cost
- Surface any potential quota or SLA impacts you might hit at scale

If that sounds useful, are you available for one of these options (PST):
- Tue 11/11 — 10:00–10:15 AM
- Tue 11/11 — 2:00–2:15 PM
- Wed 11/12 — 10:00–10:15 AM

Or feel free to pick a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood-15min

I've attached a short list of sample session IDs we pulled so we can reference the exact calls during the sync (session-sample-ids.txt). If you prefer, I can loop in a dev on our side for a quick technical question or keep it light and tactical.

Thanks — I can be flexible.

Best,
Irene Choi
Sales Development Representative
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0182

Attachment: session-sample-ids.txt (text)

Also helpful to know:

- We may want to talk about cost controls and a quick pass at model choice; Priya will want to join if it’s technical.
